credential_fields.label: Client ID
credential_fields.tip: In GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps → New OAuth App. After you register it, copy the Client ID shown on the app's page.

credential_fields.label: Client Secret
credential_fields.tip: On the same OAuth App page click "Generate a new client secret" and copy it immediately — GitHub shows the secret only once.

requires: GitHub OAuth App: Client ID + Client Secret
setup_hint: Register a new OAuth App and set its "Authorization callback URL" to the exact Redirect URI shown below.
